authority: PI, 2026-09-17: one small B-only intervention; not another giant retrain. Preserve previously learned state-conditioned GET_FLAG decisions, do not reward GET_FLAG frequency.
governs: A_FREEZE_RULE.json (A remains frozen comparator). B_CHECKPOINT_SCREENING_READING.json (NO_BASIN_FOUND). STATE_CONDITIONED_DIAGNOSIS_READING.json (genuine finding: not-carrying GET_FLAG→GO_TO).
classification: DIAGNOSTIC / EXPLORATORY. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL. Not a confirmatory Δ_B pass.
THE_HYPOTHESIS_candidate_not_established: When not carrying, continued B training systematically shifts GET_FLAG → GO_TO across essentially every context bucket in STATE_CONDITIONED_DIAGNOSIS. That is a real executed-behavior difference (unlike the retracted carrying GO_HOME label disagreement). Outcome association was weak, so this is a candidate causal lever, not 'the reason Δ_B fails'.

ANCHOR_B_better_mechanical_not_B200k.rule: use the B_better checkpoint already mechanically defined in STATE_CONDITIONED_DIAGNOSIS_SPEC.json, NOT the trajectory-win-rate peak.
ANCHOR_B_better_mechanical_not_B200k.why_not_B200k: B_CHECKPOINT_SCREENING_READING: Δ_A=-0.0625, Δ_B=-0.125. B200k is not a specialist. The intervention tests whether preserving decisions that later disappear lets subsequent B learning develop specialization; it does not claim the anchor is already specialized.

LOSS.formula: L = L_PPO + λ * 1[¬carrying_i] * 1[π_{B*} favors GET_FLAG] * D_macro(π_θ, π_{B*})
LOSS.D_macro: −log π_θ(GET_FLAG | o_i) on gated agent-heads only. Macro head only. Waypoint / mine heads are never in D. This is NOT JSD/KL on the full action distribution.
LOSS.why_macro_only: global JSD/KL could prevent useful learning elsewhere. The diagnosis identified one specific drift; constrain that drift.
LOSS.carrying_source: per-agent vec[..., 10] (own_carrying), the same field gpu_env/_core/_observations.py writes. Team-level 'any carrying' is forbidden as the gate.
LOSS.anchor_favors_GET_FLAG: argmax of the frozen anchor's legality-masked macro head equals MacroAction.GET_FLAG (=2).
LOSS.decision_points_only: gated heads must also be decision-eligible (more than one legal macro), matching sibling_separation.decision_eligible_agents. Locked commit ticks contribute no gradient.
LOSS.cadence: separate zero_grad/backward/step on cadence=4, never sharing a backward with the PPO surrogate (same discipline as sibling_sep / role_pres).
LOSS.lambda_rationale: single exploratory value, the middle of the previously proposed sibling-sep screen {0.02, 0.1, 0.5}. Thin prior. THIS IS NOT A LAMBDA SCREEN — one run only.

EXPLICITLY_FORBIDDEN: r += α 1[GET_FLAG] or any GET_FLAG-frequency / occupancy target
global JSD or KL on the full action distribution
carrier-path changes (GO_HOME / own_carrying override) — those disagreements were retracted as execution-irrelevant
any A training, A architecture, A reward, or A-specific diagnostic
auto-launching confirmatory Stage 2 regardless of the 2x2 cell

TRAINING.pole: certified B3-3 (SDS2_B3_LOCKDEF10_2V1) via --pole-b-genome-json. Missing this flag is a known train/eval invalidation.
TRAINING.warm_start: B_t500k (same zip as the frozen anchor). Weight initialization only: warm_start_reset_progress=True, global_step starts at 0, this run's budget is 200,000 steps, not an extension of the original 1M.
TRAINING.launcher: experiments/train_specialist_scale.py with --exploratory-spec this file (so artifacts cannot be mistaken for confirmatory)

manipulation_check.question: Did GET_FLAG→GO_TO drift actually decrease on the diagnosed non-carrying states?
manipulation_check.driver: Bfinal (same as the sealed diagnosis) so visit distribution is paired
manipulation_check.seeds: 18900001-18900048 (subdivides STATE_CONDITIONED_DIAGNOSIS; matched-state, not a new independent claim)
manipulation_check.query: the NEW continuation checkpoint, counterfactually, in the slot the diagnosis used for B_worse
manipulation_check.metric: among agent-steps with carrying=False AND B_better argmax=GET_FLAG, P(student argmax=GO_TO)
manipulation_check.baseline: the same metric on the sealed diagnosis's Bfinal queries (computed from state_conditioned_diagnosis_agent_step_rows.csv before this run's eval is interpreted)
manipulation_check.manipulated: NEW rate is STRICTLY lower than the Bfinal baseline

delta_B_check.question: Did Δ_B move in the correct direction without destroying the joint specialization requirement?
delta_B_check.instrument: experiments/eval_specialist_crossover_scaled.py, same protocol as B_CHECKPOINT_SCREENING (paired bootstrap, both poles, frozen pi_A3 comparator)
delta_B_check.seeds: fresh block reserved immediately before that eval, disjoint from 187/188/189/190
delta_B_check.ΔB_improved: point estimate δ_B(π_new) > δ_B(B_t500k) = −0.046875 (the screened starting checkpoint, same protocol)
delta_B_check.joint_not_destroyed: point estimate δ_A(π_new) ≥ 0. If δ_A < 0 the policy is reading as a Pole-A generalist (the B200k failure mode) and the YES/YES cell cannot fire.

cells.meaning: Promising causal repair. Scale/confirm ONLY if joint_not_destroyed also holds. That confirmatory crossover is a separate reserved seed block, not auto-launched by this spec.
